name: Rubraptor
look: a proud red-winged hawk with a crest, a black mask, a hooked grey beak, a fierce glare, a white breast, white-spotted wings and two long forked tail streamers banded with gold
entry: A proud hawk that guards its territory from the treetops. Its red wings flash like a warning as it dives, yet it is gentle with Pokémon smaller than itself and shares its catch with them.
how: Wild: rare in forests and hills.
